LanguageData.CRO_SpeakOath_Title: {PAWN} is ready to speak the {IDEAL} as a {ORDER}
LanguageData.CRO_SpeakOath_Text:
{PAWN}, a {ORDER}, is ready to speak their next {IDEALLABEL}:

"{OATH}"

Do you wish them to speak the words?
LanguageData.CRO_BondStrained_Text: {PAWN}'s bond with their spren as a {ORDER} is weakening. Their spren seems distant and troubled.\n\nResume actions aligned with their oaths to strengthen the bond.
LanguageData.CRO_BondFractured_Text: {PAWN}'s bond with their spren as a {ORDER} is seriously damaged. Their investiture regeneration is halved and their abilities are weakening.\n\nThis is urgent — {PAWN} must act in accordance with their oaths immediately, or the bond may break entirely.
LanguageData.CRO_BondBreaking_Title: {PAWN}'s spren bond is about to break
LanguageData.CRO_BondBreaking_Text: {PAWN}'s bond with their spren as a {ORDER} is on the verge of shattering. If nothing changes, the bond will break and their spren may become a deadeye.\n\nThis is critical — {PAWN} must immediately perform actions aligned with their oaths or the bond will be lost.
LanguageData.CRO_BondRegression_Text: {PAWN}'s bond with their spren as a {ORDER} has weakened significantly. They have lost the power of the {IDEAL} and regressed to a lower level of connection.\n\nTheir abilities and powers have diminished accordingly.
LanguageData.CRO_BondDeath_Text: {PAWN} has broken their oath so completely that their spren bond as a {ORDER} has shattered. Their spren is now a deadeye — a hollow, mindless shell of what it once was, condemned to wander Shadesmar with scratched-out eyes. {PAWN} has lost all Radiant powers and can never bond this spren again.
LanguageData.CRO_DeadBlade_Text: A dead Shardblade has materialized where {PAWN} once stood as a {ORDER}. The blade is inert — it can still cut, but requires ten heartbeats to summon and its spren will never again respond to its wielder.
LanguageData.CRO_FuryBreak: {PAWN} has lost control of their fury!
LanguageData.CRO_BreakBond_GizmoDesc: Deliberately sever your bond with your spren. This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.CRO_BreakBond_DialogText:
Are you sure you want to break {PAWN}'s bond with their spren?

This will permanently destroy the bond. {PAWN}'s spren will become a deadeye, all Radiant powers will be lost, and {PAWN} will suffer a lasting mood penalty.

This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.CRO_RadiantOrder_MysteryHint: The deeper meaning of this oath will reveal itself in time.
